name: Isomorphic Node Recycling (DAOG)
definition: A compression method that reuses structurally identical (isomorphic) nodes by converting the Octree into a Directed Acyclic Octal Graph (DAOG).
summary: Isomorphic Node Recycling converts Sparse Voxel Octrees to Directed Acyclic Octal Graphs by reusing identical nodes via a top-down hash-based strategy, distinguishing it from other DAG methods.
